reviews.name: James C.
reviews.text: Mark did an awesome job!  He spent so much time making sure everything was perfect.  I would say with his background he is probably one of best lighting guys in the country.  Highly recommend him on any outdoor lighting project.

reviews.name: becky i.
reviews.text:
Mark has a great eye for outdoor lighting design and landscaping.
His lighting recommendations not only enhances the beauty  but increases security. Mark is very reliable and knowledgeable. Love his lighting designs and his strong work ethic.

reviews.name: John H.
reviews.text:
Mark was so helpful with is ideas and was able to create exactly what we were looking for.  He was prompt, courteous and professional.  He stopped by numerous times after the installation to make sure everything was perfect.  I would highly recommend he and his company for any outdoor lighting or audio needs you may have.

John H

reviews.name: Airiel D.
reviews.text: Mark is professional and dependable! He did an amazing job and went beyond his scope of work. I am very pleased and would recommend him to anyone needing light design and installation.

reviews.name: Kevin M.
reviews.text: Mark with Lighthouse did an amazing job on my home. I did not install exterior lighting when I built the house, so Mark had to find some unique ways to make my house shine.  I get compliments from my neighbors and people just driving by all the time. I could not be happier, and would recommend Mark to anyone with home lightning needs.
